title: Do marriage tax penalties cause delayed marriage reporting?
title_zh: 婚姻税收惩罚是否导致延迟婚姻申报？
title_primary: 婚姻税收惩罚是否导致延迟婚姻申报？
title_secondary: Do marriage tax penalties cause delayed marriage reporting?
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-09-04 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Couples can face higher taxes when filing as married rather than unmarried. These marriage penalties may motivate newlyweds to delay reporting their marriage on U.S. tax returns. Linking Minnesota marriage records to federal tax returns, we show that marriage penalties are correlated with delayed marriage reporting. Over 2 % of newlyweds misreport their marital status. Misreporting rates increase to 14 % when marriage penalties reach $8000. Misreporting and large marriage penalties are more prevalent among similar-earning couples and EITC claimants. Misreporting couples’ behavior appears responsive to incentive changes, often correcting their filing status when marriage penalties become bonuses.
abstract_zh: 夫妻在已婚而非未婚状态下申报纳税时，可能面临更高的税负。这种婚姻惩罚可能促使新婚夫妇推迟在美国纳税申报中报告其婚姻状况。通过将明尼苏达州的婚姻记录与联邦纳税申报表相关联，我们发现婚姻惩罚与延迟报告婚姻状况之间存在相关性。超过2%的新婚夫妇虚报其婚姻状态。当婚姻惩罚达到8000美元时，虚报率上升至14%。虚报行为及高额婚姻惩罚在收入相近的夫妇和劳动所得税抵免（EITC）申领者中更为普遍。虚报夫妇的行为似乎对激励变化反应敏感，当婚姻惩罚转为婚姻奖励时，他们往往纠正其申报状态。

title: Evaluating Substitutes for Federal Antitrust: The Case of COPAs
title_zh: 评估联邦反垄断替代方案：COPA案例研究
title_primary: 评估联邦反垄断替代方案：COPA案例研究
title_secondary: Evaluating Substitutes for Federal Antitrust: The Case of COPAs
authors: Seungwhan Chun, Marco Duarte, Cici McNamara, Jason Lindo
official: 官方在线 2026-09-01 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Are state-imposed behavioral remedies effective substitutes for federal antitrust enforcement? We evaluate state regulation of hospital mergers under Certificates of Public Advantage (COPAs). Using hospital data from 1996–2022, we estimate the treatment effect of mergers for both COPA-regulated events and unregulated but similar anticompetitive events, each relative to non-merging controls. The difference between the two treatment effects isolates the impact of state-imposed behavioral remedies: in highly concentrated markets, COPA mergers result in an 11.1 p.p. lower price effect but a 0.5 p.p. greater 30-day mortality effect. We find a negative correlation between price and mortality effects for COPA mergers, consistent with theoretical predictions that binding price caps exacerbate quality deterioration. Our findings suggest that COPA contracts are poor substitutes for traditional antitrust enforcement.
abstract_zh: 国家强制的行为性救济措施能否有效替代联邦反垄断执法？我们评估了在“公共优势证书”（COPAs）下，州级对医院并购的监管情况。利用1996年至2022年的医院数据，我们估计了并购对COPA监管事件及未受监管但类似的反竞争事件的处置效应，均与未并购对照组相比。两种处置效应之差揭示了州级行为性救济措施的影响：在高度集中的市场中，COPA并购导致价格效应降低11.1个百分点，但30天死亡率效应增加0.5个百分点。我们发现COPA并购的价格与死亡率效应之间存在负相关，这与理论预测一致，即约束性价格上限会加剧质量下降。我们的研究结果表明，COPA合同难以成为传统反垄断执法的有效替代品。

title: Life, Death, and Migration in the Early Modern City: The Urban Historical Demography of WürzburgJandeVries, (Cambridge University Press, 2026. Pp. 304. ISBN 9781009641517. Hbk £95)

title_primary: 近代早期城市中的生、死与迁移：维尔茨堡的城市历史人口学研究
title_secondary: Life, Death, and Migration in the Early Modern City: The Urban Historical Demography of WürzburgJandeVries, (Cambridge University Press, 2026. Pp. 304. ISBN 9781009641517. Hbk £95)
official: 官方在线 2026-08-26 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This book addresses Allan Sharlin's well-known thesis about the role of migration in early modern urban demography.Sharlin's original article, which was published in Past and Present in 1978, challenged traditional interpretations of the reasons for the slow growth of towns and cities in this period.The conventional view regarded these cities as 'urban graveyards' which only succeeded in sustaining themselves as a result of in-migration.Sharlin argued that the characterization of early modern cities as 'urban graveyards' was exaggerated and that their slow growth was actually caused by the barriers faced by temporary migrants in the marriage market.This meant that migrants faced the same mortality risks as the 'native' population without having the same opportunity to contribute to birth rates.In 1981, he responded to criticism of this argument by proposing a detailed analysis of the demographic history of the German city of Würzburg, but he died before he could undertake this.Jan de Vries was originally asked to take over responsibility for Sharlin's project but 'the rich data yielded by Sharlin's research design enabled the writing of a demographic analysis that comprehended his thesis but went beyond it' (p.xviii).This delayed completion of the project but led to the publication of this study.The book starts by providing a detailed account of Würzburg's history before giving an introduction to its records and the questions to which they lend themselves.These can be set out as follows: (1) how family demography varied by social class; (2) whether chronic high mortality in excess of fertility prevailed in Würzburg; (3) whether pre-industrial life generated a distinctive urban fertility regime; and (4) what role migration played in either supporting or limiting population growth.As De Vries explains, Würzburg was not necessarily an ideal test of Sharlin's original hypothesis.It was the Residenzstaat, or administrative capital, of the Prince-Bishopric of Würzburg.All rights reserved, including rights for text and data mining and training of artificial intelligence technologies or similar technologies.

title: Parenthood in Poverty
title_zh: 贫困中的父母身份
title_primary: 贫困中的父母身份
title_secondary: Parenthood in Poverty
official: 官方在线 2022-12-02 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We provide comprehensive evidence on how new parenthood impacts the lives of economically disadvantaged women in the U.S. Using high-frequency individual-level administrative panel data from a large urban county combined with an event study design, we document far-reaching and persistent changes. New parenthood triggers large eligibility changes that sharply and greatly increase enrollment in Medicaid, SNAP, and TANF by more than 50\%, underscoring the profound importance of the social safety net for new mothers with low incomes. Simultaneously, new parenthood appears to motivate significant behavioral shifts, with increased uptake (+30%) in substance use disorder treatment and notable reductions in criminal behavior (-50%). However, not all is rosy: first-time parenthood precipitates increased housing instability, causing a doubling in homeless shelter stays, and eventually leading to a large and lasting increase in reliance on public housing. Robustness checks, including two separate (matched) difference-in-differences analyses, suggest robustness to endogeneity in the timing of first parenthood.
abstract_zh: 我们提供了关于新为人父母如何影响美国经济弱势女性生活的全面证据。利用来自一个大城市县的高频个人层面行政面板数据，结合事件研究设计，我们记录了深远且持续的变化。新为人父母引发了大规模的资格变动，使得医疗补助、补充营养援助计划和贫困家庭临时援助的注册率急剧且大幅增加超过50%，这凸显了社会安全网对低收入新妈妈的重要性。同时，新为人父母似乎激发了显著的行为转变，物质使用障碍治疗的参与率上升（+30%），犯罪行为显著减少（-50%）。然而，并非一切皆美好：首次为人父母加剧了住房不稳定，导致无家可归者收容所住宿时间翻倍，并最终导致对公共住房依赖的大幅且持久的增加。稳健性检验，包括两项独立的（匹配）双重差分分析，表明首次为人父母时间选择的内生性问题对结果的影响具有稳健性。

title: A Currency Premium Puzzle
title_zh: 货币溢价之谜
title_primary: 货币溢价之谜
title_secondary: A Currency Premium Puzzle
authors: Tarek Hassan, Thomas Mertens, Jingye Wang
official: 官方在线 2026-08-03 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We show that quantitative asset pricing models, built to address the equity premium and risk-free rate puzzles, systematically fail when applied to open economies: they cannot generate the large and persistent interest rate differentials we observe between risky and safe currencies. This failure stems from the key mechanism that produces their success in matching both closed-economy puzzles: In these models, the mean of the stochastic discount factor offsets its variance nearly one-for-one, which immobilizes interest rates --- so that differences in expected currency returns across countries must arise almost exclusively from predictable changes in exchange rates, at odds with the data. We prove this result in a broad class of models that allows for market incompleteness and exchange rate disconnect, requiring only that each country's risk-free asset is priced by investors who demand compensation for risk in line with observed risk premia. We argue this tension between canonical asset pricing and international macroeconomic models is a key reason researchers have struggled to reconcile the observed behavior of exchange rates, interest rates, and capital flows across countries.
abstract_zh: 我们证明，旨在解决股权溢价和无风险利率之谜的定量资产定价模型，在应用于开放经济体时系统性地失效：它们无法生成我们在风险货币与安全货币之间观察到的大幅且持续的利率差异。这一失败源于使这些模型在匹配封闭经济体两大谜题时成功的关键机制：在这些模型中，随机贴现因子的均值几乎一对一地抵消其方差，从而固定了利率——因此，各国间预期货币回报的差异几乎必须完全来源于可预测的汇率变动，这与数据不符。我们在一个广泛的模型类别中证明了这一结果，该类别允许市场不完全性和汇率脱钩，仅要求每个国家的无风险资产由那些根据观察到的风险溢价要求风险补偿的投资者定价。我们认为，经典资产定价与国际宏观经济模型之间的这种张力，是研究者们难以调和各国间汇率、利率和资本流动观察行为的关键原因。

title: Global production networks and imperfect competition
title_zh: 全球生产网络与不完全竞争
title_primary: 全球生产网络与不完全竞争
title_secondary: Global production networks and imperfect competition
authors: Hanwei Huang, Kalina Manova, Oscar Perelló, Frank Pisch
official: 官方在线 2026-07-29 · 来源：RSS
abstract: How do global production networks and market structure interact to shape the gains from trade and competition policy? We develop a quantifiable model with two-sided firm heterogeneity, matching frictions, and imperfect competition. More productive buyers match with more suppliers, which spurs tougher competition, lowers input costs, and raises profits. Reduced-form evidence confirms that larger French and Chilean firms import higher quantities at lower prices as more Chinese suppliers enter, and that suppliers charge diversified buyers lower markups. We estimate the model by extending recent methods for combinatorial discrete-choice problems. Counterfactuals reveal that entry upstream benefits primarily high-productivity buyers, while lower trade or matching costs favor mid-productivity firms. Moreover, the interaction between endogenous networks and markups significantly amplifies the welfare gains from entry upstream, as well as from packaging trade liberalization with reductions in matching or entry costs.
abstract_zh: 全球生产网络与市场结构如何相互作用，以塑造贸易收益与竞争政策？我们构建了一个可量化的模型，包含双边企业异质性、匹配摩擦和不完全竞争。生产率更高的买家与更多供应商匹配，这促进了更激烈的竞争，降低了投入成本，并提高了利润。简化形式的证据证实，随着更多中国供应商进入，较大的法国和智利企业以更低价格进口更多数量，且供应商对多元化买家收取较低的加成。我们通过扩展组合离散选择问题的最新方法对模型进行估计。反事实分析显示，上游进入主要惠及高生产率买家，而降低贸易或匹配成本则有利于中等生产率企业。此外，内生网络与加成之间的相互作用显著放大了上游进入带来的福利收益，以及将贸易自由化与匹配或进入成本降低相结合所带来的福利收益。

title: Rentier resource nationalism and overseas investment by multinational corporations: the impact of resource value
title_zh: 租金资源民族主义与跨国企业海外投资：资源价值的影响
title_primary: 租金资源民族主义与跨国企业海外投资：资源价值的影响
title_secondary: Rentier resource nationalism and overseas investment by multinational corporations: the impact of resource value
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-29 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Characterized by its predatory nature and the institutional uncertainty, rentier resource nationalism (RRN) has emerged as a critical risk factor for overseas investment by multinational corporations (MNCs). However, existing literature rarely relies on theoretical models to analyze the differential impacts of RRN across heterogeneous investment objectives. Furthermore, the underlying role of resource value remains underexplored, particularly from the perspective of “cognitive divergence”. To address these gaps, this study develops a three-stage game model and investigates how RRN and resource value affect the economic variables of MNCs. The results reveal that RRN significantly reduces the residual profit and overseas investment outlay of MNCs, while increasing metal output. Through the lens of investment objective heterogeneity, MNCs targeting residual profit maximization suffer negative shocks. Conversely, MNCs aiming to ensure more resource supply can benefit from the dynamics, and exhibit a higher tolerance threshold for RRN intensity. The ultimate impact of resource value hinges on the relative strength of the market-size driving effect versus the resource-depletion inhibitory effect. Crucially, “cognitive divergence” regarding resource value serves as an important mechanism explaining the simultaneous emergence of intensified RRN and the expansion of investment outlay. This study provides a theoretical foundation for the rational formulation of RRN policies and enriches the theoretical framework of international investment.
abstract_zh: 以掠夺性特征和制度不确定性为特征的租金型资源民族主义（RRN），已成为跨国公司（MNCs）海外投资的关键风险因素。然而，现有文献鲜有基于理论模型分析RRN对不同投资目标异质性影响的差异。此外，资源价值的基础性作用仍未得到充分探讨，尤其是从“认知分歧”的视角来看。为弥补上述研究空白，本研究构建了一个三阶段博弈模型，考察RRN与资源价值如何影响跨国公司的经济变量。研究结果显示，RRN显著降低了跨国公司的剩余利润与海外投资支出，同时提高了金属产出。从投资目标异质性的视角来看，以剩余利润最大化为目标的跨国公司遭受负面冲击；相反，旨在保障更多资源供应的跨国公司则能从这一动态中获益，并对RRN强度表现出更高的容忍阈值。资源价值的最终影响取决于市场规模驱动效应与资源耗竭抑制效应的相对强弱。关键在于，关于资源价值的“认知分歧”是解释RRN加剧与投资支出扩张同时出现的重要机制。本研究为RRN政策的合理制定提供了理论基础，并丰富了国际投资的理论框架。

title: Diagnostic testing a time series regression with zero-one dummies
title_zh: 零一虚拟变量时间序列回归的诊断检验
title_primary: 零一虚拟变量时间序列回归的诊断检验
title_secondary: Diagnostic testing a time series regression with zero-one dummies
official: 官方在线 2026-07-25 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We consider tests for normality, residual autocorrelation, and autoregressive conditional heteroskedasticity for a time series regression, which includes various zero-one dummy variables for individual observations. The sizes of these tests are distorted as the residuals associated with the dummies are equal to zero. We propose a simple solution which amounts to dismissing the observations with these zero-valued residuals, that is, treat these observations as missing. With simulations we show that the resulting tests have the proper size.
abstract_zh: 我们考虑时间序列回归中的正态性检验、残差自相关检验以及自回归条件异方差检验，该回归包含针对个体观测值的各种0-1虚拟变量。由于与虚拟变量相关的残差为零，这些检验的显著性水平存在扭曲。我们提出一个简单解决方案，即剔除这些残差为零的观测值，将其视为缺失值处理。通过模拟研究，我们证明修正后的检验具有恰当的显著性水平。

title: DP1789 Where Did all the Growth Go? External Shocks, Social Conflict and Growth Collapses
title_zh: 增长都去哪儿了？外部冲击、社会冲突与增长崩溃
title_primary: 增长都去哪儿了？外部冲击、社会冲突与增长崩溃
title_secondary: DP1789 Where Did all the Growth Go? External Shocks, Social Conflict and Growth Collapses
official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper argues that domestic social conflicts are a key to understanding why growth rates lack persistence and why so many countries have experienced a growth collapse after the mid-1970s. It emphasizes, in particular, the manner in which social conflicts interact with external shocks on the one hand, and the domestic institutions of conflict-management on the other. Econometric evidence provides support for this hypothesis. Countries that experienced the sharpest drops in growth after 1975 were those with divided societies (as measured by indicators of inequality, ethnic fragmentation etc) and with weak institutions of conflict management (proxied by indicators of the quality of governmental institutions, rule of law, democratic rights, and social safety nets).
abstract_zh: 本文认为，国内社会冲突是理解经济增长率缺乏持续性以及20世纪70年代中期后众多国家经历增长崩溃的关键因素。研究特别强调社会冲突如何一方面与外部冲击相互作用，另一方面与国内冲突管理机制相互影响。计量经济学证据支持这一假说：1975年后增长降幅最大的国家，正是那些社会分裂程度较高（以不平等程度、族群碎片化等指标衡量）且冲突管理机制薄弱（以政府机构质量、法治水平、民主权利及社会安全网等指标为代理变量）的国家。

title: (How) Do Health Shocks Reallocate Research Direction?
title_zh: 健康冲击如何（以及是否）重新配置研究方向？
title_primary: 健康冲击如何（以及是否）重新配置研究方向？
title_secondary: (How) Do Health Shocks Reallocate Research Direction?
authors: Zhou, Hongyu, Garg, Prashant, Fetzer, Thiemo
official: 官方在线 2026-07-20 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: We examine whether research systems reallocate scientific effort as health needs change. We assemble a global disease--location panel for 204 countries and territories (1990--2021) by linking disease-specific publication output to disease burden in the same place and year. Using large language models, we extract diseases from article text, map them into a standardized disease classification, and classify research funders by type. Empirically, we estimate how publication output co-moves with disease burden within countries and diseases over time, and we use event-study difference-in-differences designs that exploit plausibly exogenous variation from the timing of outbreak alerts. We find that responsiveness to endemic burden has increased over time but remains highly uneven across locations; outbreak alerts trigger rapid, statistically significant research surges that have strengthened in recent years; and funding composition is strongly associated with adjustment dynamics, with philanthropic and government-supported research contributing disproportionately to responsiveness growth in lower-income settings.
abstract_zh: 我们考察研究体系是否随着健康需求的变化而重新配置科研力量。通过将特定疾病的出版产出与同一地点和年份的疾病负担相关联，我们构建了一个覆盖204个国家和地区（1990-2021年）的全球疾病-地点面板数据。利用大型语言模型，我们从文章文本中提取疾病信息，将其映射到标准化的疾病分类中，并按类型对研究资助者进行分类。在实证分析中，我们估计了出版产出如何随国家内部和疾病随时间变化的疾病负担而共同变动，并采用事件研究双重差分设计，利用疫情警报时间点带来的看似外生的变异。我们发现，对地方性流行负担的响应性随时间增强，但在不同地点间仍高度不均；疫情警报会引发快速且统计上显著的研究激增，且近年来这种激增有所加强；资助构成与调整动态密切相关，其中慈善和政府支持的研究在低收入环境中的响应性增长中贡献尤为突出。

title: Predictably Unpredictable Inspections
title_zh: 可预测的不可预测检查
title_primary: 可预测的不可预测检查
title_secondary: Predictably Unpredictable Inspections
authors: Gandhi, Ashvin, Olenski, Andrew, Shi, Maggie
official: 来源期次 American Economic Review · 来源：期刊官网
abstract: Inspections are a common tool for acquiring information and incentivizing compliance. Though typically unannounced, they often follow a predictable schedule. We study how this predictability shapes firm effort and patient outcomes in U.S. nursing homes. Nursing homes “slack” in the low-risk period following an inspection and ramp up effort as their next inspection approaches. Patient survival mirrors this pattern, suggesting meaningful consequences for care quality. We embed these estimates in a dynamic model capturing how inspection regimes incentivize effort and reveal quality. Unpredictability induces as much additional effort as increasing inspection frequency by 10 percent, with minimal loss of informational value.
abstract_zh: 检查是获取信息和激励合规的常用工具。尽管通常不事先通知，但检查往往遵循可预测的时间表。我们研究了这种可预测性如何影响美国养老院的努力程度和患者结局。养老院在检查后的低风险期会“松懈”，并在下一次检查临近时加大努力。患者生存率也呈现相同模式，表明这对护理质量具有重要影响。我们将这些估计值嵌入一个动态模型中，该模型捕捉了检查制度如何激励努力并揭示质量。不可预测性所引发的额外努力，相当于将检查频率提高10%的效果，且信息价值的损失极小。

title: Who Wants to Break Up Big Firms? Harm, Fairness, and the Demand for Antitrust
title_zh: 谁想拆分大企业？损害、公平与反垄断需求
title_primary: 谁想拆分大企业？损害、公平与反垄断需求
title_secondary: Who Wants to Break Up Big Firms? Harm, Fairness, and the Demand for Antitrust
official: 官方在线 2026-07-20 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: The rise of superstar firms has made dominant companies central to modern economic life, and antitrust enforcement is one of the main policy tools for regulating their market power. Public opinion can shape the political and regulatory environment in which antitrust enforcement takes place, yet there is little direct evidence on what drives these preferences. We conduct a pre-registered information-provision experiment with 4,000 American households. Respondents were told about one of five real antitrust cases and randomly assigned to information treatments designed to study four potential drivers of support for antitrust enforcement: perceived market share, perceived consumer harm, perceived unfair competition, and perceived negative image. All four treatments moved the beliefs they were designed to affect, but their effects on demand for antitrust differed sharply. Information about consumer harm had the most systematic effects: it increased plaintiff support and support for break-up and conduct remedies, with effects remaining visible one month later, and also spilled over to broader support for antitrust policies. By contrast, and contrary to expert forecasts, information about market share had no meaningful effect on demand for antitrust enforcement. The findings suggest that the public thinks like economists in one key respect: they do not care about market share per se, but respond instead to consumer harm. One factor outside the core economic framework, perceived unfair competition, also matters, though its effects are more limited in scope. We discuss implications for policymakers and regulators.
abstract_zh: 超级明星企业的崛起使主导型企业成为现代经济生活的核心，而反垄断执法是规范其市场力量的主要政策工具之一。公众舆论能够塑造反垄断执法所处的政治与监管环境，然而关于哪些因素驱动这些偏好的直接证据仍然匮乏。我们对4000个美国家庭开展了一项预先注册的信息提供实验。受访者被告知五起真实反垄断案件中的一起，并被随机分配到旨在研究反垄断执法支持度四个潜在驱动因素的信息处理组：感知市场份额、感知消费者损害、感知不公平竞争以及感知负面形象。所有四种信息处理都改变了其旨在影响的信念，但它们对反垄断需求的影响存在显著差异。关于消费者损害的信息产生了最系统性的影响：它提高了对原告的支持、对拆分及行为补救措施的支持，这些影响在一个月后依然可见，并且还溢出至对更广泛反垄断政策的支持。相比之下，与专家预测相反，关于市场份额的信息对反垄断执法需求没有产生有意义的影响。研究结果表明，公众在一个关键方面像经济学家一样思考：他们并不关心市场份额本身，而是对消费者损害做出反应。核心经济框架之外的一个因素——感知不公平竞争——也具有一定影响，尽管其影响范围更为有限。我们讨论了对政策制定者和监管机构的启示。

title: The Missing Loan-to-Value Cycle
title_zh: 缺失的贷款价值比周期
title_primary: 缺失的贷款价值比周期
title_secondary: The Missing Loan-to-Value Cycle
authors: Adelino, Manuel, McCartney, W. Ben, Schoar, Antoinette
official: 卷期日期 2026-09-01 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: We show that the equilibrium loan-to-value (LTV) distribution in the US mortgage market has been remarkably stable over the last quarter century, both in aggregate and region-by-region, despite large, cross-sectionally heterogeneous house price cycles. While high-LTV mortgages changed from being explicitly government backed to privately securitized and back, their overall fraction re- mained unchanged. A repeat-sales methodology and an analysis of loan performance confirm that this stability in the distribution of LTVs holds even within subgroups of the population. These findings are inconsistent with models of credit cycles that use changes in collateral constraints to generate boom-bust dynamics in house prices.
abstract_zh: 我们证明，美国抵押贷款市场的均衡贷款价值比分布在过去25年中保持显著稳定，无论是在总体层面还是区域层面，尽管房价周期存在显著的横截面异质性。高贷款价值比抵押贷款从明确由政府支持转变为私人证券化，再回归政府支持，但其总体占比始终未变。重复销售方法及贷款表现分析进一步证实，即使在人口子群体内部，贷款价值比分布的稳定性依然成立。这些发现与利用抵押品约束变化生成房价繁荣-萧条动态的信贷周期模型不一致。

title: The Pass-through of Tariffs and Exchange Rates
title_zh: 关税与汇率的传导效应
title_primary: 关税与汇率的传导效应
title_secondary: The Pass-through of Tariffs and Exchange Rates
authors: Stéphane Auray, Michael B. Devereux, Aurélien Eyquem
official: 官方在线 2026-07-02 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This paper shows that the currency in which traded goods are invoiced has a first-order implication for the short-run impact of tariffs on the economy. If prices are set in terms of producer’s currency (PCP), a unilateral tariff is contractionary on impact, reducing GDP, and causing a deterioration in the trade balance. By contrast, with prices pre-set in buyers currency (LCP), the same tariff shock is expansionary, and improves the trade balance. The key difference between the two regimes lies in the differential exchange rate pass- through under PCP relative to LCP. In welfare terms however, the situation is reversed. A tariff under LCP leads to a fall in short-run welfare, as consumption and investment fall sharply, while the same tariff may be welfare enhancing under PCP. Under dollar currency pricing (DCP), we find results intermediate between the two invoicing regimes. With retaliation, the stark difference in pricing regimes is attenuated.
abstract_zh: 本文表明，贸易商品计价货币的选择对关税对经济的短期影响具有首要意义。若以生产者货币定价（PCP），单边关税在短期内具有紧缩效应，导致GDP下降并引发贸易逆差恶化。相比之下，若以买方货币预设定价（LCP），同等关税冲击则具有扩张效应，并改善贸易平衡。两种机制的核心差异在于PCP与LCP下汇率传导效应的不同。然而从福利角度看，情况则截然相反：LCP下的关税导致短期福利下降（因消费与投资急剧萎缩），而PCP下的同等关税可能提升福利。在美元定价（DCP）机制下，我们发现结果介于两种计价模式之间。当存在报复性关税时，定价机制间的显著差异会有所减弱。

title: Does Informal Competition Reduce Firm-Provided Worker Training among Formal Manufacturing SMEs in Sub-Saharan Africa?
title_zh: 非正式竞争是否减少了撒哈拉以南非洲正规制造业中小企业提供的员工培训？
title_primary: 非正式竞争是否减少了撒哈拉以南非洲正规制造业中小企业提供的员工培训？
title_secondary: Does Informal Competition Reduce Firm-Provided Worker Training among Formal Manufacturing SMEs in Sub-Saharan Africa?
authors: Amin, Mohammad, Rodriguez Cuniolo, Eugenia Aurora
source: World Bank Policy Research Working Papers
official: 官方在线 2026-06-29 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This paper investigates the impact of informal competition—defined as competition faced by formal firms from informal enterprises—on the firm-provided worker training among formal manufacturing small and medium-sized enterprises. Using a representative dataset of small and medium-sized manufacturing firms in 23 Sub-Saharan African countries, a sizable negative impact is found. A one-standard-deviation increase in informal competition reduces the probability that a firm offers training to its workers by 8.7 to 12.9 percentage points, relative to the sample mean of firms that offer training of approximately 25 percent. Comparable declines are observed in the share of workers receiving training. To address potential endogeneity, the paper employs several complementary strategies. First, an instrumental-variables strategy leverages variation in the number of children aged 0–4 and 5–9 years per working-age woman to generate exogenous shifts in informal competition. Second, heterogeneity is examined through tests derived from the “legalist” view of informality, which predicts bigger adverse effects of informal competition in environments characterized by a weaker rule of law and more stringent business regulations. Third, information about firms in other world regions is used to construct out-of-sample predictions of informal competition at the sector level. The findings suggest that informal competition is a substantial constraint on the training investments of formal firms, underscoring the need for policy responses that mitigate its adverse consequences.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了非正规竞争——即正规企业面临的来自非正规企业的竞争——对正规制造业中小企业提供的员工培训的影响。基于23个撒哈拉以南非洲国家中小型制造企业的代表性数据集，发现非正规竞争对员工培训存在显著的负面影响。非正规竞争每增加一个标准差，企业为员工提供培训的概率将下降8.7至12.9个百分点，而样本中提供培训的企业均值约为25%。员工接受培训的比例也出现了类似的下降。为解决潜在的内生性问题，本文采用了多种互补策略。首先，利用工具变量法，通过每名育龄妇女对应的0-4岁和5-9岁儿童数量的变化，生成非正规竞争的外生变动。其次，基于非正规经济的“合法主义”观点进行异质性检验，该观点预测在法治较弱、商业监管更严格的环境中，非正规竞争的负面影响更大。第三，利用其他地区企业的信息，构建行业层面非正规竞争的样本外预测。研究结果表明，非正规竞争严重制约了正规企业的培训投资，凸显了制定政策以减轻其负面影响的必要性。

title: An Unfunded Mandate? Medicaid Continuous Coverage Requirements and State Fiscal Burdens During COVID-19
title_zh: 无资金支持的命令？新冠疫情期间医疗补助持续覆盖要求与州财政负担
title_primary: 无资金支持的命令？新冠疫情期间医疗补助持续覆盖要求与州财政负担
title_secondary: An Unfunded Mandate? Medicaid Continuous Coverage Requirements and State Fiscal Burdens During COVID-19
official: 官方在线 2026-06-15 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: At the COVID-19 pandemic's onset, the federal government enacted substantial changes impacting both the revenues and expenditures connected to states' Medicaid programs through a pair of provisions in the March 2020 Families First Coronavirus Response Act. These included a 6.2 percentage point increase in states' Federal Medical Assistance Percentages (FMAP), which raised states' revenues, contingent on adherence to a continuous coverage requirement. The latter provision raised expenditures by preventing the disenrollment of individuals whose eligibility would otherwise have lapsed due to changes in income or other eligibility-relevant circumstances. While these provisions were ex-ante expected to result in expenditures and costs of similar magnitudes, the ex-post realizations remain unquantified. Nationwide, we estimate that states’ share of the continuous coverage provision's costs was $139.2 billion, which is roughly $11.0 billion less than the revenues states received, in aggregate, through increased FMAPs. Revenues and costs varied substantially across states, however, with costs exceeding revenues by as much as $594 per capita, and revenues exceeding costs by as much as $838 per capita. The baseline parameters governing the federal government's share of states' Medicaid expenditures emerge as a key driver of the extent to which the continuous coverage requirement can be viewed as an unfunded federal mandate.
abstract_zh: 在新冠疫情初期，联邦政府通过2020年3月《家庭优先新冠病毒应对法案》中的两项条款，对各州医疗补助计划的收入和支出实施了重大调整。这些条款包括将各州的联邦医疗援助比例（FMAP）提高6.2个百分点，从而增加各州收入，但前提是各州必须遵守持续参保要求。后者通过阻止因收入或其他资格相关情况变化而本应失去资格的参保者退出计划，增加了支出。尽管这些条款在事前预期将产生规模相近的支出和成本，但事后实际结果尚未量化。在全美范围内，我们估计各州承担的持续参保条款成本为1392亿美元，这比各州通过提高FMAP获得的收入总额少约110亿美元。然而，各州的收入和成本差异显著，成本超过收入的情况最高达人均594美元，而收入超过成本的情况最高达人均838美元。决定联邦政府承担各州医疗补助支出份额的基准参数，成为衡量持续参保要求是否可被视为无资金支持的联邦指令的关键因素。

abstract: We study the problem of measuring the popularity of artists in music streaming platforms. We uncover the space of popularity indices upon exploring the implications of several axioms capturing principles with normative appeal. As a result, we characterize several families of indices. Our characterizations might help to address the rising concern in the music industry to explore new methods that reward artists (from the revenues platforms raise by charging users) more appropriately. We actually connect our families to the new royalties models, recently launched by Spotify and Deezer.

title: Consumption Inequality, Life-Cycle Risk Sharing and the COVID-19 Crisis in a Developing Economy: Evidence from Thailand, Indonesia and Vietnam
title_zh: 消费不平等、生命周期风险分担与发展中经济体的新冠疫情危机：来自泰国、印度尼西亚和越南的证据
title_primary: 消费不平等、生命周期风险分担与发展中经济体的新冠疫情危机：来自泰国、印度尼西亚和越南的证据
title_secondary: Consumption Inequality, Life-Cycle Risk Sharing and the COVID-19 Crisis in a Developing Economy: Evidence from Thailand, Indonesia and Vietnam
authors: Mutita Ariyavutikul, Minchung Hsu, Trang Le, Trisukon Sawatrukkiat
official: 官方在线 2026-06-08 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper examines life-cycle patterns of earnings and consumption inequality in a developing economy, focusing on employment informality, risk sharing, and the impacts of the COVID-19 pandemic. Using household survey data from Thailand, with robustness checks for Indonesia and Vietnam, we find that in Thailand both earnings and consumption inequality rise with age during prime working years, and earnings inequality continues to increase after retirement. Inequality patterns differ by employment status: formalworker- headed households show limited risk sharing at younger ages, while informal-worker-headed households display flatter consumption-inequality profiles, with consumption inequality generally below earnings inequality. During the COVID-19 period, overall inequality declined, but consumption inequality increased among younger households. Finally, a standard life-cycle model calibrated to match earnings inequality fails to replicate the observed age profile of consumption inequality, suggesting that key developing-economy features, such as informal insurance mechanisms, are not fully captured.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了发展中经济体中收入与消费不平等在生命周期中的模式，重点关注就业非正规性、风险分担以及新冠疫情的影响。利用泰国家庭调查数据，并以印度尼西亚和越南进行稳健性检验，我们发现：在泰国，收入不平等和消费不平等在主要工作年龄阶段均随年龄增长而上升，且收入不平等在退休后继续加剧。不平等模式因就业状态而异：以正规工人为户主的家庭在年轻时风险分担有限，而以非正规工人为户主的家庭则呈现更平缓的消费不平等曲线，且消费不平等通常低于收入不平等。新冠疫情期间，总体不平等有所下降，但年轻家庭的消费不平等却有所上升。最后，一个为匹配收入不平等而校准的标准生命周期模型未能复现观测到的消费不平等年龄分布，这表明发展中经济体的关键特征（如非正式保险机制）未被充分捕捉。

title: Distributional tax analysis in theory and practice: Harberger meets Diamond-Mirrlees
title_zh: 理论与实践中的分配性税收分析：哈伯格与戴蒙德-米尔利斯
title_primary: 理论与实践中的分配性税收分析：哈伯格与戴蒙德-米尔利斯
title_secondary: Distributional tax analysis in theory and practice: Harberger meets Diamond-Mirrlees
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-29 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper proposes a new framework to study the distribution of current taxes and the effects of tax reforms. For current taxes, labor taxes are assigned to the corresponding workers, capital taxes to the corresponding asset owners, and consumption taxes to the corresponding consumers. Current taxes capture the wedges between pre-tax prices (relevant for production) and after-tax prices (relevant for the work, saving, and consumption decisions of households) as well as the direct equity effects of taxes while being silent about efficiency. Our method does not require structural assumptions, is internally consistent, and maximizes the comparability of tax progressivity and inequality over time and across countries. Applying this methodology to the United States, we find that the effective tax rate of the top 1% has declined from about 50% in the early 1950s to 32% in 2021. It is through the corporate tax that a high degree of tax progressivity was achieved in the middle of the 20 th century. To analyze the distributional effects of tax reforms, mechanical changes in tax liability by income groups and aggregate revenue effects due to household (but not firms’) behavioral responses are sufficient statistics in the neoclassical optimal tax model of Diamond and Mirrlees (1971). The effects of taxes on pre-tax prices at the heart of classical tax incidence analysis are normatively irrelevant.
abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种新框架，用以研究现行税收的分配状况及税制改革的影响。对于现行税收，劳动税归于相应劳动者，资本税归于相应资产所有者，消费税归于相应消费者。现行税收捕捉了税前价格（与生产相关）与税后价格（与家庭的工作、储蓄及消费决策相关）之间的楔子，以及税收的直接公平效应，而未涉及效率问题。我们的方法无需结构性假设，内部一致，并最大化税收累进性与不平等性在时间及跨国间的可比性。将此方法应用于美国，我们发现顶层1%的有效税率已从20世纪50年代初的约50%下降至2021年的32%。正是通过公司税，20世纪中叶实现了高度的税收累进性。为分析税制改革的分配效应，按收入群体划分的税收负担机械变化及因家庭（而非企业）行为反应导致的总体收入效应，在Diamond和Mirrlees（1971）的新古典最优税收模型中构成充分统计量。古典税收归宿分析中关于税收对税前价格影响的核心内容，在规范意义上并不相关。

title: The impact on adolescent health and wellbeing from adding evidence-based soft skill lessons to the high school curriculum
title_zh: 在高中课程中加入循证软技能课程对青少年健康与福祉的影响
title_primary: 在高中课程中加入循证软技能课程对青少年健康与福祉的影响
title_secondary: The impact on adolescent health and wellbeing from adding evidence-based soft skill lessons to the high school curriculum
official: 官方在线 2026-05-22 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Through a cluster randomised field trial, we evaluate the impact of an evidence-based, soft skills curriculum aimed at adolescents, referred to as Healthy Minds, that ran in 35 high schools in England over four years (2013/14 – 2017/18). We find supportive evidence that Healthy Minds positively augments the primary outcome of self-reported physical health in the treated adolescents. Treated pupils have global health attainment that is 0.235 standard deviations higher than children in the control group, resulting in a 10-percentile increase in their measured health status. We also find evidence of positive impacts on behaviour. There is no evidence of impacts on improved emotional wellbeing. We note significant gender differences in the effects found, strongly favouring boys. Overall, we provide strong evidence that a designed, taught life skills curriculum can improve related outcomes during the adolescent years, and that differential learning styles across visible aspects of diversity are worthy of consideration Healthy Minds.
abstract_zh: 通过一项整群随机实地试验，我们评估了一项名为“健康心智”的循证软技能课程对青少年的影响。该课程在英国35所高中开展了四年（2013/14至2017/18学年）。研究发现支持性证据表明，“健康心智”课程显著提升了受试青少年自我报告的身体健康这一主要结果。接受干预的学生整体健康水平比对照组儿童高出0.235个标准差，相当于其测量健康状态提升了10个百分点。我们还发现了该课程对行为产生积极影响的证据，但未发现其对情绪健康改善有显著作用。值得注意的是，干预效果存在显著的性别差异，且明显更有利于男生。总体而言，我们提供了有力证据，表明设计并教授的生活技能课程能够改善青少年时期的相关结果，同时，在可见的多样性维度上，差异化的学习风格值得在“健康心智”课程中加以考量。

title: 税收征管数字化升级与上市公司所得税费用偏差
title_zh: 税收征管数字化升级与上市公司所得税费用偏差

title: Final-offer arbitration with reference-dependent preferences
title_zh: 参考依赖偏好的最终报价仲裁
title_primary: 参考依赖偏好的最终报价仲裁
title_secondary: Final-offer arbitration with reference-dependent preferences
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-02-27 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: When negotiators fail to reach agreements, arbitration is used to resolve disputes. This study examines final-offer arbitration (FOA), in which an arbitrator selects one of the negotiators’ offers as the binding outcome. FOA encourages pre-arbitration settlements by increasing the risks associated with arbitral uncertainty. Nevertheless, negotiators often proceed to arbitration in practice. To address this, we characterize the conditions under which negotiators either reach an agreement or escalate to FOA. Our model incorporates reference-dependent preferences and the uncertainty over arbitral decisions. Negotiators incur costs of losing in FOA that depend on their offers, and an arbitrator is drawn from a probability distribution. We reveal a necessary and sufficient condition for agreements under a general class of distributions. FOA facilitates settlements only when negotiators’ costs are sufficiently high relative to the odds of “gambling” in arbitration. We demonstrate that the condition becomes distribution-independent under linear utilities.
abstract_zh: 当谈判者未能达成协议时，仲裁被用于解决争端。本研究考察最终报价仲裁（FOA），即仲裁员从谈判者的报价中选择其一作为具有约束力的结果。FOA通过增加仲裁不确定性相关的风险来促进仲裁前和解。然而，实践中谈判者往往仍会诉诸仲裁。为解决此问题，我们刻画了谈判者达成协议或升级至FOA的条件。我们的模型纳入了参考依赖偏好及仲裁裁决的不确定性。谈判者在FOA中承担失败成本，该成本取决于其报价，且仲裁员从某一概率分布中抽取。我们揭示了一般分布类别下达成协议的必要且充分条件。仅当谈判者的成本相对于仲裁中“博弈”的几率足够高时，FOA才能促进和解。我们证明，在线性效用下，该条件与分布无关。

title: The US–China tension and global reallocation of Chinese STEM talents
title_zh: 中美紧张局势与全球STEM领域中国人才的重新配置
title_primary: 中美紧张局势与全球STEM领域中国人才的重新配置
title_secondary: The US–China tension and global reallocation of Chinese STEM talents
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2025-11-20 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Science knows no borders, but is never detached from politics. We study a lesser-noticed consequence of the US–China tension since 2018: the downturn in STEM educational services trade. Our analysis reveals a pronounced drop, exceeding 40%, in Chinese STEM students pursuing graduate study in the US. Visa restrictions, geopolitical uncertainties and anti-US sentiments reduce the allure of US education, prompting students to seek alternatives in other foreign countries or China. The two reallocation effects are comparable, suggesting similar elasticities of substitution. Further analyses find that females tend to relocate to other foreign countries more than males do.
abstract_zh: 科学无国界，但从未脱离政治。我们研究了自2018年以来中美紧张局势中一个较少被注意的后果：STEM教育服务贸易的下滑。我们的分析显示，中国STEM学生赴美攻读研究生的人数显著下降，降幅超过40%。签证限制、地缘政治不确定性和反美情绪降低了美国教育的吸引力，促使学生转向其他国家或中国寻求替代选择。这两种重新分配效应相当，表明替代弹性相似。进一步分析发现，女性比男性更倾向于转移到其他外国国家。

title: China’s supply chain digitalization policy and carbon risk exposure: the role of CEO attributes
title_zh: 中国供应链数字化政策与碳风险暴露：CEO特质的作用
title_primary: 中国供应链数字化政策与碳风险暴露：CEO特质的作用
title_secondary: China’s supply chain digitalization policy and carbon risk exposure: the role of CEO attributes
authors: Miaomiao Tao Emilson Silva David Roubaud Aviral Kumar Tiwari a Energy Centre, Department of Economics, Business School, The University of Auckland, New Zealandb Department of Finance 等
official: 官方在线 2025-08-04 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We investigate the impact of China’s supply chain digitalization policy on firm-level carbon risk, utilizing a quasi-experimental framework from 2013 to 2021. We substantiate the policy’s significant role in reducing carbon-related risks, with the extent of mitigation influenced by factors such as firm characteristics, pollution levels, financial constraints, and ESG performance. We further investigate the mechanisms linking supply chain digitalization to carbon risk, focusing on CEO-related factors. The results indicate that political ties exacerbate carbon risk, though their interaction with digitalization policies yields a risk-reducing effect. Instead, CEO turnover and narcissism positively influence this relationship. Further investigation reveals that the policy enhances firms’ participation in global innovation networks, substantially alleviating corporate carbon risk exposure. Our study provides timely insights into how digitalization policies can be a strategic tool for firms to align with global sustainability goals while managing carbon-related uncertainties.
abstract_zh: 我们利用2013至2021年间的准实验框架，考察了中国供应链数字化政策对企业层面碳风险的影响。我们证实了该政策在降低碳相关风险方面的重要作用，其缓解程度受企业特征、污染水平、财务约束及ESG表现等因素的影响。我们进一步探究了供应链数字化与碳风险之间的关联机制，重点关注首席执行官相关因素。结果表明，政治关联加剧了碳风险，尽管其与数字化政策的交互作用产生了风险降低效应。相反，CEO更替和自恋特质对此关系产生正向影响。进一步研究发现，该政策增强了企业参与全球创新网络的程度，显著减轻了企业碳风险敞口。我们的研究为数字化政策如何成为企业对接全球可持续发展目标、同时管理碳相关不确定性的战略工具提供了及时见解。

title: Reassessing India’s Poverty Decline over the Missing Decade: 2011-12 to 2022-23
title_zh: 重新评估印度“缺失十年”（2011-12至2022-23）的贫困下降
title_primary: 重新评估印度“缺失十年”（2011-12至2022-23）的贫困下降
title_secondary: Reassessing India’s Poverty Decline over the Missing Decade: 2011-12 to 2022-23
official: 官方在线 2025-02-03 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This paper addresses the lack of official data on Indian poverty between 2011-12 and 2022-23, a period known as the "missing decade". It critiques two major attempts to estimate poverty during this time: one using national account growth rates and the other using a private survey. These methods are criticised for their assumptions and data limitations. The paper proposes a new method, imputing consumption from official labour force surveys using a wage-based model. The authors find that poverty reduction was not as dramatic as previously suggested, with about 20% of Indians living in poverty on the eve of the pandemic. The paper's analysis aligns with the fact that India's structural economic transformation was limited, with agriculture output stagnant and regional convergence lacking. The paper concludes that while poverty may have gone down, but its rate of decline has been slow in the decade after 2011-12.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了2011-12年至2022-23年间印度贫困数据缺失的问题，这一时期被称为“缺失的十年”。文章批判了在此期间估算贫困的两种主要方法：一种基于国民账户增长率，另一种依赖私人调查数据。这两种方法因其假设条件和数据局限性而受到质疑。本文提出了一种新方法，即利用基于工资的模型，从官方劳动力调查中推算消费数据。作者发现，贫困减少的幅度并不像此前所暗示的那样显著，疫情前夕约有20%的印度人生活在贫困中。本文的分析与印度结构性经济转型有限的事实相符，表现为农业产出停滞且缺乏区域趋同。文章得出结论：尽管贫困可能有所减少，但2011-12年后的十年间，其下降速度一直较为缓慢。

title: Unconditional Convergence in Manufacturing Productivity across U.S. States: What the Long-Run Data Show
title_zh: 美国各州制造业生产率的无条件收敛：长期数据的启示
title_primary: 美国各州制造业生产率的无条件收敛：长期数据的启示
title_secondary: Unconditional Convergence in Manufacturing Productivity across U.S. States: What the Long-Run Data Show
official: 官方在线 2023-04-09 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This paper examines long-run unconditional convergence of labour productivity in manufacturing across 48 contiguous U.S. states. For that purpose, we construct a detailed panel data set of state-industry pairs with over 120 industries covering the period 1880-2007. We find that unconditional β-convergence in manufacturing productivity was pervasive and rapid – 7.6% per year in 1880-2007 – and that manufacturing accounts for most of the unconditional convergence contribution to overall productivity growth over the long run: 61% in 1880-1940 and 91% in 1958-2007. We also examined broad U.S. regions and found that in the South the contribution of unconditional β-convergence in manufacturing to aggregate productivity growth before World War II was weak not because of a slower convergence rate but a much smaller manufacturing sector.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了美国本土48个州制造业劳动生产率的长期无条件收敛性。为此，我们构建了一个涵盖1880-2007年、包含120多个行业的州-行业配对面板数据集。研究发现，制造业生产率的无条件β收敛具有普遍性与快速性——1880-2007年间年均收敛率为7.6%——且制造业对长期总体生产率增长中无条件收敛的贡献占比最大：1880-1940年间为61%，1958-2007年间为91%。我们还考察了美国主要区域，发现二战前美国南部地区制造业无条件β收敛对总体生产率增长的贡献较弱，其原因并非收敛速度较慢，而是制造业部门规模过小。
